compare internal sales vs market sales i:
WITH Internal AS (
  SELECT ib.name, SUM(ms.product_quantity) as qty 
  FROM "master_sale" ms 
  JOIN "customer_details" cd ON ms."customer_id" = cd."customer_id" 
  JOIN "ims_brick" ib ON cd."ims_brick_id" = ib."id" 
  WHERE ms.area_name ILIKE '%F.B.AREA%' 
  GROUP BY 1
),
Market AS (
  SELECT ib.name, SUM(s."unit") as qty 
  FROM "ims_sale" s 
  JOIN "ims_brick" ib ON s."brickId" = ib."id" 
  WHERE ib.name ILIKE '%F.B.AREA%' 
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(i.name, m.name) AS "Brick Name", 
  COALESCE(i.qty, 0) AS "Internal Units", 
  COALESCE(m.qty, 0) AS "Market Units"
FROM Internal i 
FULL OUTER JOIN Market m ON i.name = m.name
ORDER BY "Internal Units" DESC;

manager farman ali ke total visits batow:
WITH visits AS (
  SELECT 
    "managerId",
    "doctorId",
    "healthCentreId",
    "visited_date",
    "status"
  FROM 
    "doctor_plan"
  WHERE 
    "managerId" = (SELECT "id" FROM "managers" WHERE "name" ILIKE '%Farman Ali%')
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS "Total Visits",
  SUM(CASE WHEN "status" = 'VISITED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Completed Visits",
  SUM(CASE WHEN "status" = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Pending Visits",
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT hc."name", ', ') AS "Visited Health Centres"
FROM 
  visits v
  LEFT JOIN "healthcentres" hc ON v."healthCentreId" = hc."id";
